# Quickstart: Validate the OCP 5.0.1 Operator Review & OpenShell 0.1.8 Upgrade

**Date**: 2026-11-14 | End-to-end validation guide for [spec.md](spec.md). Implementation details live in `tasks.md` (generated by `/speckit.tasks`); stage contracts in [contracts/acceptance-suite.md](contracts/acceptance-suite.md).

## Prerequisites

- Workstation: `oc` (logged in to minilab sno), `openshell` CLI, `make`, `yq`, `helm`, `python3`; repo at `minilab` root.
- Cluster: OpenShift 5.0.1, healthy; Argo CD reachable; DNS resolves the cluster's zone.
- Gateway auth available (`OPENSHELL_NO_BROWSER=1 openshell gateway login k8s` if tokens expired).
- Git: commit rights on `main` (delivery is direct commits, per Clarifications 2026-11-14).

## Scenario 1 — Operator layer aligned to 5.0.1

```bash
# 1. Review artifact covers every subscription (contract: operator-review.md)
yq -r '.clusterGroup.subscriptions | keys[]' values-prod.yaml | sort > /tmp/expected
sed -n '/^## Operator Review/,/^## Catalog Snapshot/p' specs/014-ocp501-openshell-upgrade/review-log.md | grep -E '^### ' | sed 's/### //; s/ — .*//' | grep -v '^patterns-operator$' | sort > /tmp/recorded
diff /tmp/expected /tmp/recorded && echo "review complete"

# 2. Git pins updated (lvms on stable-5.0; coo approval Automatic)
yq -r '.clusterGroup.subscriptions.lvms-operator | .channel + " " + .csv' values-prod.yaml
# expect: stable-5.0 lvms-operator.v5.0.0
yq -r '.clusterGroup.subscriptions.cluster-observability-operator.installPlanApproval' values-prod.yaml
# expect: Automatic

# 3. Cluster converged and healthy
oc get csv -A | grep -E 'lvms|cluster-observability'
# expect: lvms-operator.v5.0.0 Succeeded; cluster-observability v1.5.5 (or hold recorded) Succeeded
oc get subscription -A   # expect: no UpgradePending, no ResolutionFailed without a recorded HOLD
```

**Expected outcome**: every operator healthy on a 5.0.1-compatible channel or carrying a documented hold; no manual drift (all differences traceable to Git).

## Scenario 2 — OpenShell at 0.1.8

```bash
# 1. Pin set atomic at 0.1.8 (all five surfaces — see data-model.md)
yq -r '.clusterGroup.applications.openshell.chartVersion' values-prod.yaml          # 0.1.8
grep 'tag: "0.1' overrides/values-openshell-gateway.yaml                            # three 0.1.8 tags
make check-openshell-cli                                                             # pass, unmodified
openshell --version                                                                  # 0.1.8

# 2. Running platform matches
oc -n openshell get pods -o jsonpath='{range .items[*]}{.spec.containers[0].image}{"\n"}{end}' | grep 0.1.8
openshell status -g k8s                                                              # gateway answers
```

**Expected outcome**: gateway pod image tag `0.1.8`, gateway status succeeds, CLI matches, Argo CD `openshell` applications Synced+Healthy.

## Scenario 3 — Acceptance suite (behavior as expected)

```bash
make test-static && make validate-openshell        # stage 1
./pattern.sh make validate-schema                  # stage 2
make check-openshell-cli                           # stage 3 (covered above)
make argo-healthcheck                              # stage 4
make validate-openshell-live                       # stage 5 — no skip
DEMO_PROMPT="Reply with exactly: OPENSHELL_VDEMO_OK" make validate-openshell-demo   # stage 6 — no skip
```

Then the manual lifecycle check (stage 7): create a sandbox with policy supplied at create (feature-012 mechanism), verify the policy is effective from the first operation (allowlisted egress succeeds, non-allowlisted denied), delete it, and confirm `openshell sandbox list` is empty.

**Expected outcome**: every stage passes with results recorded in `review-log.md`; any failure is fixed-and-rerun or documented with an upstream reference (see [contracts/acceptance-suite.md](contracts/acceptance-suite.md) for the 0.1.8 behavior deltas to expect).

## Completion check

```bash
openshell sandbox list        # empty — zero residual
oc get subscription -A        # no pending/failed without recorded holds
make validate-cluster         # constitution workflow gate green
git -C . log --oneline -8     # pin/review/evidence commits on main
```

All green → the feature satisfies SC-001…SC-005 and is ready for `/speckit.converge`.
